text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a very successful performance
beneath an
underpass, Smart Falcon is
seeing off her fans.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for coming,
everyone! I'll see
you all at the next
one! ♪

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text: E-erm... Hey, Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeees? ☆
...Oh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You were in the back row... with the
handmade
fan, right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
H-huh? Y-you... you remember? There
were so
many people, but you remember
me? How come?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You made that fan just for today, didn't
you? That makes me super happy. ☆
Thanks for always
showing up to my
performances. ♪

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
No waaay! You're a goddess among
goddesses! I
can't believe you
remembered me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't exaggerate! ☆ Anyways,
you had
something to tell me, right?

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! I was just wondering if
you'd record a message of support for
my childhood
friend... Unless that's too
much to ask...

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
It's just,
my friend is a huge fan of yours
as well,
but she's too busy to leave our
hometown...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's no trouble at all!
I'll be her very own

cheerleader!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Y-y-you're seriously an angel sent from
heaven... My friend has been stressing
out and feeling
down, but this will
definitely cheer her up!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Here's hoping
my voice
can lift her spirits a little.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I know! I've got a better idea than just
recording a
message! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
What would you say if I told you I'd put
on a
winning concert near where your
friend lives?

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I-if you did that, she'd be able to come
too!
B-b-but... why would you go that far
for us?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'd do anything for my fans! That's what
being an
Umadol is all about!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text: Faaa... Fal... Falcooo!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text: I-i-incre... Incredible! Beyond incredible! I... I can't breathe... Gasp...

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh... right! Sorry! I'm from Hokkaido!
Would you
be able to come to the
racecourse in Sapporo or
Hakodate?
choice_data_list: B-By the way, where's your hometown?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! Hokkaido? ♪ I bet if I ate some
delicious
cheese and crab before a
concert, I'd never run
out of energy! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer? We can go, riiight?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! I'll be aiming for center stage, so
make
sure you're there cheering me
on! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Smart Falcon promises she'll
appear in
a winning concert near her
fan's hometown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Time to put together a strategy to claim
center
stage at either Sapporo or
Hakodate.
